recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser-native mobile canvas RPG called `Cozy Chaos Witch: Life Sim RPG`. Preserve the mechanic truth of a drag-to-move survival arena with an automatic orbiting weapon, enemy waves, XP scoring, loot upgrades, level progression, boss spawn after enough kills, HP failure, victory on boss defeat, and restart. Present it as a satirical cozy life simulator: a pixel cottage witch glides through a pastel meadow, slays chore spirits with a rainbow tea ladle, collects self-care upgrades, and faces the Deadline Crow. Use pixel art cues, soft-girl rainbowcore palette, meme-tone HUD copy, mobile-friendly panels, catalog-backed fonts/audio, and procedural Canvas/CSS art.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Reality
- genre: mobile canvas action RPG / survival arena
- objective: drag the hero, survive enemy waves, collect upgrades, defeat the boss after enough kills
- input model: one-thumb pointer/touch drag to move; attack is automatic orbiting weapon
- core loop: spawn enemies, kite them, orbit weapon hits them, earn XP, collect loot, level up every 10 kills, boss at 30 kills
- fail/friction state: HP depletion from contact/projectiles or boss collision triggers game over; boss defeat triggers victory

## Protected Mechanics
- Drag-to-move semantics and canvas-scoped touch handling
- Auto-orbit attack timing and collision role
- Enemy spawn cadence, enemy movement archetypes, projectile pressure, circular collision checks
- Loot upgrades: damage, speed, defense, healing
- XP scoring, 10-kill level cadence, 30-kill boss spawn, HP failure, boss victory, restart reset

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD copy, world nouns, canvas drawing, procedural background, avatar/enemy/loot silhouettes, color palette, fonts, particles, floaters, buttons, audio mapping, and start/fail/victory copy.

## Remix Target
A satirical cozy life simulator RPG called `Cozy Chaos Witch`, where a soft-girl cottage witch cleans a magical meadow, slays chores, collects self-care upgrades, and fights the Deadline Crow without changing the action-survival mechanics.
